g.text: One locomotive's trip through the turntable
Loco L1 arrives after L0 has parked in hangar H1. Position 0 is the entry track, H1 to H5 are 60 degrees apart.
1. Lock the entry, call the table
4. Table turns to free hangar H2
From step 3 the entry is free,
so the next loco can queue on
it while L1 is still turning.
step 5: one loco at a time.
